description: Scopes Tauri's IPC bridge to the 'main' window, and additionally exposes it to tc-npc's own loopback origin. The mascot window loads a REMOTE page (tc-npc's own HTTP server, not bundled app content -- see WebviewUrl::External in src/main.rs), so without this 'remote' block Tauri would refuse that page any IPC access at all, and the drag-handle script injected from src/main.rs (DRAG_HANDLE_SCRIPT) would have no way to call the start_dragging command. Permissions are kept to exactly the one command that script uses -- nothing else is exposed to remote content.
